name: Snitch
tagline: Fast-fashion menswear brand, online and in stores
excerpt: Menswear brand Snitch won an all-shark deal on Shark Tank India Season 2 and has since grown into one of India's larger D2C fashion labels.
content:
Snitch sells trend-led menswear such as shirts, trousers and jackets, first online and now through its own stores. It was founded by Siddharth Dungarwal.

On Shark Tank India Season 2, Episode 20, which aired on 27 January 2023, Dungarwal asked for ₹1.5 crore for 0.5%, valuing Snitch at ₹300 crore. The sharks pushed back on the valuation, and he accepted an all-shark deal of ₹1.5 crore for 1.5%, which Entrackr reported as a ₹100 crore valuation.

Since then Snitch has raised much larger rounds. Inc42 reported in June 2025 that, according to its filing and a company statement, Snitch raised ₹338.4 crore in Series B funding led by 360 ONE Asset. In April 2026 the founder told Inc42 that operating revenue reached ₹900 crore in FY26, up about 80%; those numbers were unaudited. Inc42 also reported 115 stores at that time.

Snitch is one of the clearest examples of a Season 2 founder who accepted a lower on-air valuation and went on to raise at far higher ones.

shark_tank.pitch_summary: Siddharth Dungarwal pitched his fast-fashion menswear brand at a ₹300 crore valuation. The sharks valued it lower, and he took an all-shark deal of ₹1.5 crore for 1.5%.

faq.q: Did Snitch get a deal on Shark Tank India?
faq.a: Yes. It took an all-shark deal of ₹1.5 crore for 1.5% in Season 2, Episode 20.
The founder told Inc42 that FY26 operating revenue was ₹900 crore (unaudited).

faq.q: Has Snitch raised money since Shark Tank?
faq.a: Yes. Inc42 reported a ₹338.4 crore Series B led by 360 ONE Asset in 2025.

faq.q: Where can I buy Snitch clothes?
faq.a: On the brand's website and in its own stores.

lessons: Accepting a lower valuation for a full panel of investors brought visibility the brand later turned into larger rounds.
Fast product turnover is the core of a fast-fashion pitch; sharks probe inventory and margins.
Company-stated revenue should be read alongside audited filings when they appear.
notes: Sharks: Entrackr and Inc42 list six names (including Amit Jain) for the all-shark deal, although five sharks sit per episode; verify against the episode before publishing. FY26 revenue is unaudited and company-stated. Series B: Inc42's original filing-based figure was ₹278.93 cr; updated to ₹338.4 cr from a company statement. City not sourced.
